import re
pattern = re.compile(r"(?:[^\d]*(\d+)[^\d]*)+")
for s in ['rc9', '0009.dev', 'build.9', 'alpha', 'rc.9']:
    match = pattern.search(s)
    print(f"{s!r}: match={match.group(1) if match else None}")
